item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "0eb9c77949b1cb661ac524dd925f6baf90a9f03bdc755116e56587b12dd33ffc",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "Abbreviation for LocalDef003 with component index set Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side asserts existence of time and composed-flux spatial derivatives whose sum is zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Abbreviation for LocalDef004 with component index set Fin m.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side asserts existence of time and spatial derivatives of q satisfying the equation with the supplied linear map.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For a finite index set ι, there exist vectors qt and fluxx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ flux(q(ξ,t)) has derivative fluxx at x, and qt + fluxx = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines all three conjuncts and the two existential vector witnesses on the left side of the equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "For a finite index set ι, there exist vectors qt and qx such that τ ↦ q(x,τ) has derivative qt at t, ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x, and qt + fluxDerivative(q(x,t))(qx) = 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines all three conjuncts on the right side. Its existential qx is locally bound and distinct in scope from the target's universally supplied qx.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Real scalar multiplication on the space of real-valued functions on any index type is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuous scalar action needed to express vector-valued derivatives in the local predicates; adds no hypothesis on q.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive monoid underlying an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive operations used in constructing scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap",
      "meaning": "The type of continuous semilinear maps for the specified scalar ring homomorphism; for the identity homomorphism on R these are continuous R-linear maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each value of fluxDerivative is a continuous linear endomorphism of R^m. This does not impose continuity of fluxDerivative as a function of its state argument.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Continuous multiplication gives a continuous scalar action of a type on itself by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Establishes continuity of the real scalar action on each real component.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality of the norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed real scalar field required by the derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative action underlying a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action used on real components.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring underlying a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations for the vector-space infrastructure without changing them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, inverse, division, and associated operations as a semifield structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate real scalar structure; imposes no additional restriction on the mathematical data.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the finite type of natural-number indices i with 0 ≤ i < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vectors have exactly m real components; m = 0 yields an empty component index set.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified vector-valued derivative at the specified scalar point, using the full neighborhood of that point with the base point fixed.",
      "effect_on_target": "All time and spatial derivatives are ordinary derivatives at real points, not derivatives restricted to a subset or one-sided derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HasFDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified continuous linear Fréchet derivative at the specified point, using its full neighborhood.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires fluxDerivative(q(x,t)) to be the actual Fréchet derivative of flux at q(x,t), with no corresponding assertion at other states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each proposition implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conclusion asserts both directions between the two local derivative-and-equation predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring supplies the continuity properties required of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers continuity of real operations into the scalar-action infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul",
      "meaning": "Multiplication in a topological semiring is jointly continuous.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real multiplication used for continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action underlying a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real scalar multiplication used in derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication underlying a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar-action instance without changing multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid underlying a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real multiplicative monoid used in scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action while supplying a weaker required structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m ranges over all nonnegative integers, with no positivity assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations of a nonunital commutative ring while forgetting the requirement of multiplicative associativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a weaker real algebraic structure for continuity instances; the actual operations remain unchanged.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring, forgetting multiplicative commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the topology-of-operations infrastructure for R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, distributivity, and zero laws while forgetting additive inverse structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the weaker real structure required for continuous multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid underlying the specified semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real addition and zero to the scalar module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic nonunital commutative ring from its normed structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real ring operations in the topological scalar-action construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital seminormed ring, forgetting multiplicative commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a structural route to the real seminormed additive group.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive normed infrastructure for the real module without changing its topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of ordinary real additive operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and field used by derivative predicates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's additive, multiplicative, and metric structures without requiring a multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the corresponding weaker structure on R for topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed commutative ring as seminormed, preserving its norm, ring operations, and induced pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Keeps the usual real norm and topology in the scalar module construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic field from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real field operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Regards a normed field as a normed commutative ring with the same norm, metric, and ring operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real normed-ring infrastructure needed for continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A normed field is a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by field multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each real component carries its ordinary real vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module underlying a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real scalar multiplication to the function-space module.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Equips functions I → β with the pointwise module structure inherited from β.",
      "effect_on_target": "R^m has componentwise vector addition and real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative groups form an additive commutative group under pointwise operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector differences and sums in the derivative predicates use componentwise real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative monoids form an additive commutative monoid under pointwise addition and zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies vector addition and zero for the continuous linear maps and equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology, defined as the topology generated by the coordinate evaluation maps.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fin m → R has its usual finite-dimensional product topology, governing all vector-valued continuity and derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure supplied by a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the usual real distance to the topology used in derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all vector components, and all scalars are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field has positive norm values in every positive open interval.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivially normed scalar field instance required for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies componentwise addition, negation, and subtraction in R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative monoid structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and zero for vector and module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instMul",
      "meaning": "Real-number multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the multiplication underlying real scalar multiplication and its continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "The ring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the ordinary real algebra used in the derivative infrastructure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The real numbers with their usual commutative ring operations, norm, and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the standard real normed-ring structure used for scalar modules and topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field equipped with its usual norm and metric, with multiplicative norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "All differentiation and real linearity use the usual real normed field.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Real distance is d(x,y) = |x − y|, with its associated uniform structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Neighborhoods and limits use the ordinary real topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure of ordinary real addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar algebra for modules and the identity scalar homomorphism.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semiring from a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves real addition and multiplication in the instance construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "RingHom.id",
      "meaning": "The ring homomorphism mapping every scalar to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "The continuous semilinear maps in the target are ordinary real-linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the division-semiring operations of a semifield while forgetting multiplicative commutativity as a requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate real scalar structure with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar operation used in the componentwise continuous action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, additive and multiplicative operations, and pseudometric while dropping the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of the real seminormed additive group without altering its operations or topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying seminormed ring from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a route to the real pseudometric used for scalar-action continuity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric structure underlying a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real topology in the continuous scalar-action instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's multiplication, identity, powers, and absorbing zero as a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative structure used for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring operations while forgetting multiplicative associativity as a requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the structure needed to form the identity ring homomorphism on R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital semiring from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports extraction of ordinary real additive structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the real topology and hence the product topology used in all continuity and derivative assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of scalar multiplication on each component implies joint continuity of the pointwise scalar action on the product.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides continuous real scalar multiplication on Fin m → R for vector-valued differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "The real numbers with their specified topology form a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of real multiplication and therefore of the scalar actions used in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates all indices in Fin n using the finite list of indices below n.",
      "effect_on_target": "Discharges the finite-index requirement of LocalDef003 and LocalDef004, including when m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each side requires both derivative assertions and its zero-sum equation simultaneously.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap.funLike",
      "meaning": "Coerces a continuous linear map to the function underlying its linear map.",
      "effect_on_target": "fluxDerivative(q(x,t))(qx) is evaluation of a linear operator on a vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the function represented by a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the supplied continuous linear map to act on the spatial derivative vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The zero-sum conditions are exact vector equalities, equivalently equalities at every component.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each side independently quantifies two derivative vectors; the second witness is within the scope of the first.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite enumeration of all elements of a type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The local definitions use finite component types, instantiated in the target by Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "HAdd.hAdd",
      "meaning": "The addition operation supplied by a heterogeneous-addition instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here both operands and the result are vectors in R^m, so this is ordinary vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal in the type specified by its numeral instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "The literal 0 in each equation denotes the zero vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "Pi.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Function addition is pointwise: (f + g)(i) = f(i) + g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Each vector equation requires a zero sum at every component i < m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Pi.instZero",
      "meaning": "The zero function has value zero at every index.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right-hand side of each vector equation is the function i ↦ 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "Ordinary real-number addition.",
      "effect_on_target": "Component sums in both equations are real sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real number zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Each component of the zero vector is the real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the numeral 0 as the zero supplied by a zero instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the equation's numeral 0 to pointwise vector zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "instHAdd",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's ordinary addition as heterogeneous addition with equal operand and result types.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed addition is exactly the supplied pointwise vector addition.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "ContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "Joint continuity of the scalar-action map (a,v) ↦ a • v.",
      "effect_on_target": "This is structural continuity of real scalar multiplication; it asserts no continuity of q or of the state-dependent map fluxDerivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "Pi.instSMul",
      "meaning": "Scalar multiplication on functions is pointwise: (a • f)(i) = a • f(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector derivatives and linear maps use ordinary componentwise real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "For every natural number m ≥ 0, let V = {v : Fin m → R}, identified with R^m.",
      "For every function q : R → R → V, with q(x,t) denoting its value at spatial coordinate x and time coordinate t.",
      "For every function flux : V → V.",
      "For every function fluxDerivative : V → L_R(V,V), where L_R(V,V) consists of continuous real-linear endomorphisms of V.",
      "For every x,t ∈ R and every supplied vector qx ∈ V.",
      "On the left of the equivalence, there exist qt ∈ V and then fluxx ∈ V, with the latter witness in the scope of qt.",
      "On the right of the equivalence, there exist qt ∈ V and then v ∈ V, where v renames the locally bound qx to distinguish it from the supplied outer qx. Witnesses on the two sides are independently quantified and may depend on the fixed outer data."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "The function ξ ↦ q(ξ,t) has derivative qx at x.",
      "The function flux has Fréchet derivative fluxDerivative(q(x,t)) at the state q(x,t)."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
